planets.name: 类地星
planets.title: AURORA / TERRESTRIAL
planets.terrain: 偏心内海、弯曲大陆、分水岭与河谷
planets.description: 低地的建筑和森林共享连续地表，矿区顺山脚展开，主城与科研沿海湾连接。
planets.detail: 研究所与指挥中心之间的海湾坡地，草地连续穿过配套建筑，只有入口及装卸口局部硬化。
planets.specific:
WORLD: a lush temperate ocean planet. Original AURORA sea palette deep teal-blue #075779 to turquoise shallows #208f9b; pale sandy coves #d8c68b, sage/moss grass #68a765 and #447f52, dark faceted conifers #2e784e, small cool off-white peaks #e5ebe4. Geography must be a NEW asymmetric world: one broad crescent-shaped northern continent wrapping an off-center inland sea, a narrow curving isthmus, a long diagonal mountain watershed, branching rivers with estuaries, and an irregular southern island chain. Coastlines are jagged and varied, no evenly spaced islands. Keep land and sea in generous continuous shapes, not tiny noisy triangles.
Distribute a developed network of facilities across the whole sphere: command and research in adjoining sheltered bay foothills, mine partially excavated into a natural ridge, crystal processing beside a natural exposed vein, solar on a sunny long hillside, logistics by a navigable coastal inlet, radar on a clear ridge, manufacturing and energy on inland terraces. No world-covering paved city. Rich trees in natural patches leaving useful clear spaces, not planted in rows or rings. Show several landmarks visibly curving toward the lower and side limbs.
The close-up MUST show the research complex and neighboring command/support buildings sitting directly in a shared continuous green slope and natural valley; irregular ground and vegetation between modules, a narrow branching path, no enclosing pad edges. Text only: AURORA / TERRESTRIAL, SURFACE DETAIL, FAR SIDE.

planets.name: 金属岩星
planets.title: AURORA / METAL WORLD
planets.terrain: 玄武岩高地、分支熔沟与偏心火山群
planets.description: 建筑避开熔流，跨谷运输把矿区、精炼和装运连成真实生产路线。
planets.detail: 钻机贴自然矿壁，厂房在连续玄武岩缓坡上，只有短输送带跨过地面高差。
planets.specific:
WORLD: the AURORA metal-rich volcanic rocky planet, NOT a recolored Earth. An irregular oblique continent-spanning fault network cuts through broad dark desaturated basalt highlands; one off-center broken volcanic caldera feeds a branching lava drainage system, with two smaller volcanoes at different distances. Black/blue-charcoal rock and dusty gray-brown stable plains dominate; clear warm-orange lava sits recessed inside the chasms. Restrained emissive accents, no blinding bloom. A broad intact basalt upland occupies much of the lower hemisphere. Fault widths and land masses vary greatly; NOT a soccer-ball Voronoi mosaic, not uniform plate tiles, no every-building-on-its-own-rock pedestal.
Buildings use original AURORA ivory, dark blue-gray and warm gold, staying bright enough against charcoal land. The large yellow metal drill and refinery cling to a natural ore escarpment and lead into shared processing/logistics on nearby stable slope. Other facilities occupy safe interior plateau land, not lava banks. Thin freight bridges span only the narrowest ravine crossings. Some utility pipes descend along a cliff; small retained walls follow real rock ledges. Otherworldly but clear and cartoon, no forests, green grass or oceans.
The close-up shows drill -> hopper -> short conveyor -> storage/loading on a continuous NATURAL basalt shoulder, varied heights and a purposeful freight route. The molten rift is outside the facility, not a circle surrounding it. Text only: AURORA / METAL WORLD, SURFACE DETAIL, FAR SIDE.

planets.name: 火星岩星
planets.title: AURORA / CRYSTAL RIFTS
planets.terrain: 赤色高原、主裂谷与不对称支谷
planets.description: 晶体沿断层生长；建筑沿不同高度的天然岩台分区，桥梁只跨狭口。
planets.detail: 晶体采集架沿矿脉落位，研究与仓储在相邻岩台，天然岩壁保持连续。
planets.specific:
WORLD: the AURORA red crystal-rift rocky planet, NOT Earth tinted red and NOT the volcanic planet's fault network. Broad burnt-terracotta plateaus and pale ochre eroded mesas are cut by ONE dominant diagonal Y-shaped canyon with unequal tributaries; an eroded flat basin lies off-center on the opposite side. One arm is narrow and deep, another broad with layered sediment benches, the third fades into wind-sculpted desert. Natural cyan and violet crystal outcrops follow only sections of exposed canyon strata. Their glow is subtle and contained, not a luminous ocean or evenly spaced crystal fence. No lava, no large ocean, no forest.
Give this sphere its own mountain silhouettes, basin positions and distribution of buildable land. Main landmarks occupy different-height natural canyon shoulders and broad stable plateau interiors; the crystal mine directly touches an exposed vein, research labs nearby but on stable ground, cargo warehouse upstream of a narrow bridge crossing, solar on a broad illuminated mesa, radar on a distinct rocky promontory. Preserve the supplied recognizable buildings with warmer ivory to sit in the red terrain. Buildings at all visible latitudes, including lower curved land, not a crown on top.
Close-up: the purple crystal harvesting rig follows an irregular exposed natural vein on a canyon shoulder; nearby lab, small maintenance/storage pods sit at different natural levels with compact FOOTPRINT-only contact foundations and a short bridge at a genuine gap. No cleared discs or artificial round platforms. Text only: AURORA / CRYSTAL RIFTS, SURFACE DETAIL, FAR SIDE.

planets.name: 气态巨星
planets.title: AURORA / CLOUD WORLD
planets.terrain: 错位云带、偏心巨型风暴与分层浮空站
planets.description: 没有地面山体，功能浮台跨多个纬度分布，短桥只连接邻近配套。
planets.detail: 采气涡轮、储罐与维护舱各自依附窄长浮架，云层从设施下方连续经过。
planets.specific:
WORLD: a true Jupiter-like GAS GIANT, a continuous spherical atmosphere with no solid ground. Broad cream, warm peach/copper and muted blue-gray cloud belts curl at unequal latitudes, one LARGE OFF-CENTER oval storm in the southern mid-latitudes and several much smaller shear eddies; uneven bands twist and merge, not tidy concentric painted stripes. Cloud shading is stylized and softly faceted, not fluffy cottonballs glued to a rock sphere. Original AURORA warm/cool balanced palette and clear flat illustrated lighting.
EXCEPTION TO GROUND CONTACT: every facility floats ABOVE the continuous cloud surface on purpose-shaped space-engineering structures. Use compact narrow H-shaped service frames, paired elongated hulls, branched cantilever decks and several connected small support pods, all dark navy/ivory with restrained cyan hover units. NO ROUND DISCS, no polygon coins, no giant common circular saucers, no artificial rock islands. Frame outlines follow the actual facility footprint, with open gaps letting clouds show through. Different functions get different platform outlines. Thick gas pipes connect turbine/compressor/tanks within the harvesting group; short rigid service bridges connect nearby auxiliary pods. Distant stations are not joined by a giant spiderweb of roads; transport is by small cargo craft shown very sparingly.
Many landmark complexes distributed across the sphere's latitude/longitude and visible around side/lower limbs at several modest heights, all outward-radial. Gas intake and three-tank facilities are prominent. Command dome, research ring, solar wings, fusion unit, robot hall, logistics and radar remain recognizable. Metal/crystal processing can occupy imported-feedstock cargo decks without any fake mountain, quarry or earth mound. Do not place the lunar flagship yard on this gas world.
Close-up: a turbine/compressor/tank group on a thin branched FLOATING framework with matching little control, purification and loading pods, clouds visible under and between them. No circular platform. Text only: AURORA / CLOUD WORLD, FLOATING DETAIL, FAR SIDE.

planets.name: 月球（补充）
planets.title: AURORA / LUNAR FOUNDRY
planets.terrain: 偏心月海、叠覆陨坑、断崖与月面浮空船坞
planets.description: 月面基地、雷达和虫洞顺地貌落位；重型旗舰船坞在低重力环境中悬浮。
planets.detail: 浮空旗舰中心与半成品深空吞噬者，后方能看到未经圆盘式平整的月面和基地。
planets.specific:
WORLD: a small complete lunar sphere. Original AURORA quiet matte stone palette: cool ash-gray highlands, darker blue-gray broad ancient lava plain occupying one off-center hemisphere, asymmetrical overlapping impact craters of varied sizes, a long broken scarp and a fan of ejecta ridges. No water, trees, red lava, or atmospheric cloud bands. Craters are NATURAL depressed geological features, with broken and eroded rims; buildings must NEVER sit on raised circular crater-shaped construction pads. Keep broad smooth-ish faceted expanses between geological features.
Use the FOUR existing lunar facility types distributed across different parts of the visible surface and limbs: three-lobed Moon_Base with small greenhouse/communications/supply pods seated directly in the irregular ground on a mare edge; dual-arc deep-space scanner on a clear natural ridge; hexagonal wormhole station in a stable saddle with a clear approach; a massive FLOATING Flagship_Center above a lunar basin, completely detached from the terrain with a strong air gap. The floating shipyard has paired elongated service rails, rear command bridge, yellow manipulators and four small attached floating support pods. In its open center hangs a HALF-BUILT Iron_Behemoth: broad-front/narrow-rear triangular carrier with separated forward prongs, one armored shoulder and one side of exposed structural ribs. Do not put the flagship yard on the lunar ground, do not give it a continuous floor or a circular disc underneath. It may be the dominant landmark but must not cover most of the moon.
Close-up focuses on the hovering yard and its unfinished carrier with the unmodified crater basin BELOW and a compact grounded habitat visible nearby, so the difference between floating shipyard and ground buildings is obvious. FAR SIDE shows the same moon's dark mare continuing and a different crater/scarp pattern, not a duplicated front. Text only: AURORA / LUNAR FOUNDRY, LOW-G ASSEMBLY, FAR SIDE.

Buildings point radially outward from the local spherical surface, follow its curvature, and remain large iconic landmarks. Each main facility has a few smaller purposeful supporting structures. Right 30 percent: one close-up of a real part of THIS SAME planet, clearly demonstrating architecture-to-terrain integration, and below it a small view of the opposite hemisphere showing independent additional geography and buildings, not a mirrored copy. Keep a quiet dark navy background with very sparse stars; no orbit rings or unrelated spaceships, no fantasy floating rock islands. Simple fine separators, minimal small labels only.
INTEGRATION IS CRITICAL: natural terrain forms one continuous spherical surface underneath and BETWEEN facilities. There are NO artificial circular building islands, NO round platforms, NO polygon-disc or coin pedestals, NO round clearings, NO colored biome circles around buildings, NO rings of rocks, NO separate diorama chunks. A round dome or reactor is allowed; a round terrain pad underneath it is not. Buildings have only thin FOOTPRINT-SHAPED structural feet, embedded naturally into local ground, with small rectangular/irregular aprons only where a door or cargo route needs them. Flatten just the individual structural contact footprints, not an entire district; grass, soil, rock, slopes and shared paths continue between small support facilities. Short retaining edges can disappear into a hillside. Roads follow valleys and contours, branch for genuine access, cross a ravine at a narrow spot, and never form a repeated ring-road template. Neighboring facilities share useful access rather than each occupying an isolated board-game tile.
Use distinctive existing facilities (command dome with wedge wings, tilted-ring research lab, giant dish radar, yellow drill mine, purple crystal harvester, blue solar wings, donut fusion unit, open robot assembly hall, glass nanofactory, cargo hangar, greenhouse terraformer and space elevator). Do not turn them into repeated generic cubes. A small orbital dock may appear only where connected to the space elevator. Terrain and structure are visually legible at a glance.

WORLD: a small complete lunar sphere. Original AURORA quiet matte stone palette: cool ash-gray highlands, darker blue-gray broad ancient lava plain occupying one off-center hemisphere, asymmetrical overlapping impact craters of varied sizes, a long broken scarp and a fan of ejecta ridges. No water, trees, red lava, or atmospheric cloud bands. Craters are NATURAL depressed geological features, with broken and eroded rims; buildings must NEVER sit on raised circular crater-shaped construction pads. Keep broad smooth-ish faceted expanses between geological features.
Use the FOUR existing lunar facility types distributed across different parts of the visible surface and limbs: three-lobed Moon_Base with small greenhouse/communications/supply pods seated directly in the irregular ground on a mare edge; dual-arc deep-space scanner on a clear natural ridge; hexagonal wormhole station in a stable saddle with a clear approach; a massive FLOATING Flagship_Center above a lunar basin, completely detached from the terrain with a strong air gap. The floating shipyard has paired elongated service rails, rear command bridge, yellow manipulators and four small attached floating support pods. In its open center hangs a HALF-BUILT Iron_Behemoth: broad-front/narrow-rear triangular carrier with separated forward prongs, one armored shoulder and one side of exposed structural ribs. Do not put the flagship yard on the lunar ground, do not give it a continuous floor or a circular disc underneath. It may be the dominant landmark but must not cover most of the moon.
